title: Orcid Device Flow Script
definition: An automated script that follows the ORCID device flow for secure credential retrieval and real owner verification.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A tool that helps verify your ORCID account without sharing credentials.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A script that implements the ORCID device flow for secure credential retrieval.
difficulty_levels.expert: A novel script that implements the ORCID device flow with real owner verification through green verification blocks.

extra_fields.insight: The ORCID device flow script streamlines the user experience and enhances security by automating the process and implementing real owner verification.
